First stable release of All Radio Tools: one app to explore everything that transmits around you.

- Wi-Fi: scanner, LAN devices, ping, traceroute, ports, DNS, UPnP, Bonjour, Whois, Wi-Fi Direct, network audit, rogue access points, captive portal and man-in-the-middle detection
- Bluetooth: BLE scanner with identification, GATT device, Hot/Cold, unknown tracker detection (AirTag, AirPods, Galaxy SmartTag, Tile, Google tag) with an AirGuard-style list
- Mobile network: serving cell, neighbouring cells, cell tower map
- GNSS: satellite sky with a world map, position comparison
- SDR (HackRF): spectrum analyser, ADS-B aircraft, radiosondes (RS41, M10, M20) with landing prediction, FM radio, AIS ships, APRS, Meteor-M weather satellites, drones (analogue FPV, DJI, ExpressLRS, Crossfire, FrSky, FlySky, Spektrum remote controls)
- Handheld radio: read and write channels over a USB cable
- In-app updates from GitHub
